classification: preregistered defensive-asset ballast follow-up to R315-R319; no A/B parameter search
question: R315-R319 已证明旧 A/B 内部调参无法改善年度稳定性。把 R312 冻结双袖作为权益复合袖，加入可交易的中长久期国债 ETF 做 60 日逆波动风险平价，并无杠杆限制总暴露，能否在不牺牲年化的前提下改善 2022/2023、随机一年正收益率和滚动一年正收益率？

primary_defensive_asset.name: 上证10年期国债ETF
primary_defensive_asset.reason: 上市早于回测起点，久期高于5年期国债ETF；作为独立利率收益源

data.equity_composite: R312 A/B 60d inverse-vol risk parity, A bounds [0.2,0.8], then 15% vol target [0.2,1.0], frozen

portfolio_rule.rebalance: monthly, first common trading day; target uses returns strictly before that day
portfolio_rule.asset_weights: inverse-volatility between the frozen R312 equity composite and the selected treasury ETF
portfolio_rule.volatility_estimate: trailing 60-day covariance using the inverse-vol asset weights
portfolio_rule.warmup: first 60 aligned returns use equity weight 0.5 and gross exposure 0.5
portfolio_rule.leverage: not allowed; equity and treasury weights are nonnegative and their sum is <= 1.0
portfolio_rule.cost_application: round-trip cost times one-way portfolio turnover including cash movement

variants.primary_10y: frozen R312 composite + 511260.SH under the portfolio_rule
variants.robustness_5y: same rule with 511010.SH instead of 511260.SH; robustness check only, not selected on performance

gates.D1_data: both ETF series cover >=95% of aligned R312 dates; no duplicate dates, null close, or nonpositive close
gates.G4_calendar_stability: primary calendar 2022 return >=0 and calendar 2023 return >=0
gates.G5_bootstrap: 20-day circular block bootstrap, 1000 paths, 252 days: positive rate >=80% and return P5 >= -12%
gates.G6_rolling_year: actual rolling 252-day positive rate >=70% and worst rolling 252-day return >= -15%
gates.G8_stress: 3x allocator round-trip cost full-path return >0 and MDD >= -25%
gates.G9_incremental: versus frozen R312 on the same dates: Sharpe improves by >=0.05 or MDD improves by >=3pp; annual return is no worse than R312 minus 1.0pp
gates.G10_no_leverage: every monthly equity and treasury weight is >=0 and their sum is <=1.0
gates.R1_robustness: 5Y robustness variant has calendar 2022 and 2023 each >=0 and MDD >= -20%

selection_rule: D1 + G1-G10 + R1 all pass -> R324 becomes candidate_for_concentration_audit only. Any failure -> selected=null, retain R312 holding-profile caveat, and record negative knowledge. No weight, window, target-vol, ETF or gate changes after seeing results.

bootstrap.method: circular 20-trading-day block bootstrap from the primary daily return sequence

known_limitations: Treasury ETF qfq prices are provider-adjusted and are not an official point-in-time archive.
The portfolio rule is tested after R315 failure, so R324 is a targeted follow-up rather than independent discovery.
The equity composite uses R40 local research data, current industry snapshots and current factor versions.
A pass is only a candidate for a separate concentration, liquidity and paper-execution audit.
